title: Cash Pickup Shortfall Credits: Courtesy for Senders Who Also Use Bank Deposit
content:
**What is the courtesy?** It is an amount added to Paloma's shortfall credit on a short Cash Pickup payout when the sender also sends Bank Deposit transfers.

**What is counted?** The Bank Deposit payouts sent for the sender, that is, the payout-sent entries on the sender's Bank Deposit transfers. Only payouts dated less than twelve whole months before the day of the credit are counted.

**How much is added?**

| Bank Deposit payouts sent in that window | Courtesy added (USD) |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2.00 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 6 | 1.00 |
| none | none |

**Does the size of the Bank Deposit transfers matter?** No. Only the number of payouts sent in the window counts.

**What about a payout dated more than twelve whole months before the day of the credit?** It is outside the window and is not counted.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- 5 Bank Deposit payouts sent in the window: 1.00.
- 6 Bank Deposit payouts sent in the window: 2.00.
- No Bank Deposit payouts sent in the window, though older ones exist: none.
